topics.name: Multimodal Learning with Missing Modalities
topics.summary: Masked-feature recovery, time-aware fusion, and auxiliary sensory supervision improve prediction when channels are absent, noisy, or inconsistent. Evaluations focus on robustness to incomplete inputs and mismatched modality representations.

topics.name: Multimodal Model Evaluation and Benchmarking
topics.summary: New datasets and controlled tests assess visual-language systems on spatial language, physical reasoning, scientific signals, layout transfer, and context-sensitive understanding. Zero-shot and few-shot results expose gaps between fluent outputs and dependable grounding.

topics.name: Mechanistic Interpretability and Model Behavior Auditing
topics.summary: Counterfactual tests, activation and path probes, causal interventions, and sparse-feature analyses reveal shortcuts, inconsistent reasoning, bias, and training-induced behavioral changes. The papers connect observable outputs with internal computation rather than relying on accuracy alone.

topics.name: Synthetic Media Forensics and Concept-Based Explainability
topics.summary: Frozen visual encoders, spatial concept probes, language anchors, and open-set distance models identify manipulated or generated imagery while exposing the cues behind decisions. The methods support unfamiliar-source detection and more human-readable attribution.

topics.name: Language-Guided Embodied Robotics
topics.summary: Language- and video-conditioned robots convert instructions into navigation, flight, and coordinated manipulation through retrieval memories, lightweight adaptation, and closed-loop checks. The emphasis is transfer to new scenes while retaining reusable foundation-model components.

topics.name: Robot Motion Planning and Safe Control
topics.summary: Model-predictive control, spectral motion primitives, constrained trajectory learning, and residual adaptation address dynamics, contact, and actuation limits. Tests span manipulators, high-speed serving, underwater inspection, and verified feasible control policies.

topics.name: Efficient Visual Recognition
topics.summary: Compression, factorized features, attention modules, and lightweight transfer reduce computation while preserving recognition quality under radar, face, and embedded-device conditions. Results emphasize interpretable features and practical latency rather than unconstrained model size.

topics.name: Geometric and Spectral Representation Learning
topics.summary: Intrinsic coordinates, curved-space aggregation, frequency-aware filters, and structure-preserving parameterizations expose useful organization hidden by ordinary Euclidean features. The approaches improve transfer across domains, scales, and spatial representations without full retraining.

topics.name: Anatomical and Topology-Aware Medical Segmentation
topics.summary: Anatomical prototypes, cross-region correspondences, topology constraints, weak scribbles, and frequency-aware features improve boundaries in difficult 3D and ultrasound scans. Robustness checks also examine distribution shifts, thin structures, and fragmented labels.

topics.name: Clinical Radiology and Brain Imaging
topics.summary: Task-aware acquisition, multi-view clinical evidence, promptable radiology models, MRI synthesis, graph-based diagnosis, and mechanistic perfusion modeling reduce imaging burden while preserving clinically relevant structure. Studies cover neurological diagnosis, lesion fidelity, and scanner or sequence variation.

topics.name: Stochastic Optimization and Sequential Decision Theory
topics.summary: Proxy observations, stochastic approximation, concentration arguments, and robust generalized-linear bandits reduce the cost of selecting good actions under noisy feedback. Theoretical guarantees are paired with regret, sample-efficiency, and heavy-tail analyses.

topics.name: Optimization Geometry and Stochastic Dynamics
topics.summary: Path-based complexity analysis, causal perturbations, Hessian geometry, learning-rate scaling, and Langevin dynamics characterize how optimization trajectories explore or avoid unstable regions. The work links local curvature and stochastic noise to convergence and transient safety.

topics.name: Graph Learning and Structural Robustness
topics.summary: Spectral encodings, inductive logical reasoning, path-based graph features, and perturbation analyses address directional, heterogeneous, and changing relational structure. Applications include database-derived graphs, molecular prediction, and continuous graph-signal generation.

topics.name: Diffusion Models on Graph Structures
topics.summary: Stochastic diffusion processes are adapted to graphons and hypergraphs for size-transferable synthesis and uncertainty-aware representation learning. Theoretical stability and moment results accompany experiments on graph generation and relational detection.

topics.name: Spatiotemporal Forecasting and Remote Sensing
topics.summary: Spatial, temporal, spectral, and contextual features are used for traffic bursts, fires, smoke, coastal blooms, and cross-sensor change detection. Strict geographic, temporal, and event-level holdouts test whether models transfer beyond familiar conditions.

topics.name: Environmental Resilience Modeling
topics.summary: Earth observations, coupled economic-biophysical simulations, and probabilistic influence models identify how environmental or household shocks propagate through public systems. The studies use these models to compare recovery pathways and intervention priorities.

topics.name: Risk-Aware Cooperative Perception for Autonomous Driving
topics.summary: Structured traffic-event resources and sensor or V2X error analyses connect perception mistakes with downstream driving risk. The recurring aim is better semantic and causal supervision for false-object, occlusion, and communication-related failures.

topics.name: Human-AI Social and Affective Interaction
topics.summary: Agent-based studies of trust, network exposure, cooperation, creative partnership, emotion, and EEG-linked behavior show that interaction quality depends on social expectations as well as model outputs. The results favor context-sensitive evaluation over isolated task scores.

topics.name: AI Evaluation and Measurement
topics.summary: Adaptive challenges, deployment replays, simulator checks, human-calibrated scoring, factor selection, and agreement analysis expose how evaluation design changes conclusions about capability and safety. Reference quality and latent measurement assumptions are recurring sources of error.

topics.name: Retrieval-Grounded Question Answering
topics.summary: Adaptive retrieval, hidden-state uncertainty, source tracing, candidate reranking, and continuously updated memory help systems decide which evidence to use and when to verify it. Human judgments remain important because automated answer metrics can miss unsupported or conflicting evidence.

topics.name: Efficient Language-Model Memory and Long Context
topics.summary: Sparse external stores, phrase-indexed memory, structured recurrent attention, positional rescaling, and linearized updates extend usable context while limiting GPU use and latency. Experiments measure both long-range recall and preservation of short-range detail.

topics.name: Structured Clustering and Missing-Data Imputation
topics.summary: Latent subgroup discovery, alternating cluster refinement, historical retrieval, and generative completion preserve heterogeneity when observations are incomplete or unlabeled. The methods target more faithful structure recovery than local interpolation or fixed-class assumptions.

topics.name: Agent Workflow Optimization and Failure Localization
topics.summary: Tool recombination, role specialization, retrieval, and judge-based verification improve complex agent workflows. Across underwriting, architecture search, and multi-agent execution, tracing the earliest decisive error is as important as assigning complementary capabilities.

topics.name: Agent Safety and Multi-Agent Security
topics.summary: Distributed attacks, unsafe tool writes, biased skill judges, and graded trajectory checks reveal failures hidden by binary success or attack rates. The papers advocate deterministic safeguards and monitoring that covers interactions among agents and tools.

topics.name: Long-Horizon Agent Reliability and Self-Improvement
topics.summary: Hierarchical memory, specialist oversight, health-margin forecasting, deterministic search traces, and targeted failure mining support extended autonomous work. Checkable experience is converted into training signal while monitoring detects degradation that surface success can conceal.

topics.name: Efficient Language-Model Systems
topics.summary: Speculative drafting, low-precision communication, activation-sensitive pruning, recurrent attention, spatial GPU execution, quantization, evolutionary search, and early exits allocate computation unevenly to preserve useful behavior at lower cost.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning and Exploration
topics.summary: Verifiable penalties, asynchronous updates, population search, selective reference feedback, competing solvers, and expressive action distributions improve exploration and multi-step reasoning. The recurring finding is that informative feedback matters more than simply increasing rollout volume.

topics.name: Validated Sequential Reasoning and Hierarchical Search
topics.summary: Trace validation, recovery actions, backtracking, delegation, and role-specific search examine how agents solve problems with delayed errors. Results indicate that decomposition and verification can improve smaller executors without requiring uniformly larger models.

topics.name: Language-Model Alignment and Persona Control
topics.summary: Low-rank trait editing, appraisal-based dialogue control, adversarial personality training, causal jailbreak analysis, and token-level risk signals shape model behavior without broadly erasing capability. Tests cover both consistent persona expression and harmful-response suppression.

topics.name: AI Governance and Healthcare Assurance
topics.summary: Governance frameworks, bounded self-improvement, clinical capability taxonomies, value specifications, and institutional attack models connect system autonomy with oversight requirements. The papers emphasize measurable limits, human involvement, grounding, and post-deployment monitoring.

topics.name: Culturally Grounded Language-Model Bias
topics.summary: Multilingual stereotype resources and in-culture validation improve coverage of locally meaningful harms. Mitigation experiments show that reducing one targeted bias can shift associations for other groups, so evaluation must track spillover effects.

topics.name: LLM Confidence and Reasoning Reliability
topics.summary: Latent confidence, entity familiarity, self-play detectors, equivalence-controlled math tests, and longitudinal interaction studies probe whether internal signals predict factual or reasoning reliability. Models often retain interface-sensitive errors and weak abstention despite useful hidden indicators.

topics.name: Verified Code Synthesis and Software Engineering
topics.summary: Program regeneration, compiler and runtime feedback, security-aware editing, executable scientific tests, hardware comparisons, and code-review studies evaluate generated software by behavior and accountability rather than text similarity.

topics.name: LLM-Assisted Data Workflows
topics.summary: Language-model agents support spatial transcriptomics, product-attribute labeling, and data-science tasks through orchestration, synthetic supervision, and reusable instructions. The studies find that domain-specific validation determines whether automation is dependable.

topics.name: Diffusion-Based Visual Generation, Editing, and Restoration
topics.summary: Diffusion trajectories, inversion, conditional editing, rare-defect synthesis, appearance transfer, and adversarial scene generation control realism and structural change. Evaluations balance reconstruction fidelity, diversity, downstream utility, and preservation of unaffected content.

topics.name: 3D Scene Reconstruction and Gaussian Mapping
topics.summary: Persistent scene graphs, ray-guided reconstruction, probabilistic evidence fusion, Gaussian splats, and geometric constraints improve pose consistency and spatial fidelity for robotics and controllable driving environments.

topics.name: Generative 3D Assets and Human Avatars
topics.summary: Generative geometry and texture models, shared UV representations, and complementary motion or appearance cues produce more controllable characters and human reconstructions from sparse sensor observations. Physical plausibility and animation readiness complement visual quality.

topics.name: Sparse Visual Attention and Token Selection
topics.summary: Query-dependent token retention, spatial pruning, and sparse attention reduce redundant visual context for multimodal prediction. Inference-time selection improves fine-grained performance under fixed token and compute budgets without changing the backbone.

topics.name: Video Understanding and Multimodal Temporal Analysis
topics.summary: Temporal grouping, motion-shape-texture fusion, and dense-scene benchmarks address object continuity, sports anticipation, crowd counting, and movement assessment. Difficult frames and sparse labels remain the main source of performance loss.

topics.name: Interactive Visual Analytics
topics.summary: Natural-language queries, sketches, composition graphs, cohort comparison, and traceable evidence let experts explore complex visual collections iteratively. The systems emphasize flexible search and comparison instead of fixed dashboards or isolated inspection.

topics.name: Generalizable Robot Manipulation and Demonstration Learning
topics.summary: Object-centric scenes, spatially aligned proprioception, reusable primitives, egocentric demonstrations, fleet supervision, and selective trajectory reuse improve manipulation transfer. Simulated and physical tasks test compositional behavior, long horizons, and embodiment changes.

topics.name: Contact-Aware and Dexterous Robot Manipulation
topics.summary: Tactile prediction, haptic interfaces, force estimation, hand retargeting, visual geometry, and compliance-aware grasping improve control of deformable, articulated, and tool-like objects. The studies value low latency, surface transfer, and safe physical interaction.

topics.name: Social Robotics and Cooperative Interaction
topics.summary: Communicative motion, voice-activity timing, consent-sensitive initiation, socially influenced movement, and cooperative affordances model robot behavior around human expectations. Safety and coordination constrain both when a robot acts and how it signals intent.

topics.name: Robot Navigation under Dynamic and Distribution Shifts
topics.summary: Latent behavior prediction, event-based localization, adaptive temporal weighting, terrain-aware control, zero-shot stress tests, and depth-based collision prediction address people, slopes, unfamiliar layouts, and execution noise.

topics.name: Interactive World Models and Embodied Simulation
topics.summary: Persistent interactive 3D environments, morphology-aware hardware, robot-focused video pretraining, and Hamiltonian dynamics support action-conditioned prediction and embodied-policy training. Scalability, state persistence, and physical consistency are recurring concerns.

topics.name: Distributed and Neuromorphic Robot Control
topics.summary: Synchronization graphs coordinate modular bodies despite unit loss, while adaptive low-dimensional spiking manifolds support real-time control on neuromorphic hardware. Both use compact distributed dynamics to enable behavioral switching and fault tolerance.

topics.name: Plant Reconstruction and Under-Canopy Robotics
topics.summary: Photogrammetric point clouds recover whole-canopy growth and fine plant structure, while geometric mapping and branch-aware planning guide climbing robots toward occluded stems and targets.

topics.name: Soft Robotic Exogloves for Hand Rehabilitation
topics.summary: Personalized pneumatic exogloves model hand anatomy and joint motion to improve conformal contact, targeted actuation, and fine-motor assistance. Pressure and fabrication studies also examine compression effects relevant to spasticity management.

topics.name: Physics-Guided Design and Scientific Optimization
topics.summary: Topology guidance, connectivity penalties, multi-fidelity search, parameter-space geometry, error indicators, and adaptive surrogate refinement make engineering optimization more efficient while retaining physical constraints.

topics.name: Learning-Based Simulation of Nonlinear Dynamics
topics.summary: Equivariant probabilistic emulators, Koopman representations, Hermite or PCA features, and hardware-aware surrogates model bubbles, reactions, fluids, and ocean processes. Evaluation stresses preservation of dynamical statistics under limited resources.

topics.name: Physics-Informed Inverse Problems
topics.summary: Physics-informed operators, sparse nonlinear recovery, compact process models, uncertainty-aware validation, and differentiable thermal inference recover hidden properties from limited measurements. Guarantees and physical consistency complement predictive error.

topics.name: Quantum Machine Learning for Classification
topics.summary: Quantum or quantum-inspired feature maps, path signatures, stabilizer features, and ensembles of specialized experts support image and temporal classification. Studies also quantify circuit-solver, hardware, and cost limitations.

topics.name: Robustness, Calibration, and Certification
topics.summary: Probabilistic post-training, Lipschitz controls, combinatorial guarantees, and lower bounds connect confidence quality with robustness under shift. The papers treat calibration and certifiable operating regions as complementary reliability requirements.

topics.name: Speech and Assistive Movement Modeling
topics.summary: Speech-aware sequence models, codec-token speaker representations, gait diffusion, ultrasound sensing, sEMG gesture recognition, and temporal video analysis recover identity or movement information from compact signals. Personalization and subject-independent transfer are central evaluation goals.

topics.name: Privacy-Preserving Federated and Synthetic Data
topics.summary: Continual-release accounting, malicious-server memorization tests, differentially private tabular synthesis, and one-shot private aggregation study the tradeoff between participation privacy, fairness, and downstream utility.

topics.name: Vision-Language Model Robustness and Calibration
topics.summary: Spectral perturbations, structured infrared attacks, relational attribute prompts, and calibration-aware adaptation probe how intermediate representations affect vulnerability and confidence. The results connect adversarial behavior with relational reasoning quality.

topics.name: Scientific Multimodal Foundation Models
topics.summary: Domain-specific pretraining combines clinical figures with molecular, protein, or crystal structure evidence for scientific reasoning. The papers show that native representations and physically meaningful evaluation improve transfer beyond generic web-trained features.

topics.name: Diffusion Sampling and Policy Alignment
topics.summary: Guidance correction, timestep prioritization, replayed trajectories, and feedback-efficient policy updates target uneven denoising behavior and unstable diffusion-based optimization. The methods improve sample quality or alignment without adding large inference burdens.

topics.name: Continual Learning and Selective Unlearning
topics.summary: Sequential adaptation updates foundation models as domains and facts change, while targeted unlearning removes specified multimodal associations. Both examine retention, collateral damage, and preservation of unrelated capabilities.

topics.name: Generalization across Variable Structures
topics.summary: Sampling bounds for variable-size sequences, graphs, and tensors are paired with local rules that generate weights for unseen network layouts. The shared question is how learned behavior can remain reusable when input or architecture structure changes.
